results.evidence: The test writes b'\xff\xfe' to a config file, calls config.load_config, expects ConfigError, and asserts str(path) is in the message. config.py now catches UnicodeDecodeError and raises ConfigError with the path. The test passed (1 passed).
results.quote:
path.write_bytes(b"\xff\xfe")
    with pytest.raises(config.ConfigError) as raised:
        config.load_config(path)
    assert str(path) in str(raised.value)
